entries.label: Kotlin
entries.description: Our primary backend language. Mature ecosystem, excellent Java interop, and strong team expertise.

entries.label: Scala
entries.description: Too complex for enterprise. Lack of up to date tooling.

entries.label: Spring Boot
entries.description: Standard framework for building backend services. Well-understood by the team.

entries.label: TypeScript
entries.description: Default language for all frontend and Node.js work. Type safety prevents entire classes of bugs.

entries.label: Next.js
entries.description: Evaluating for our web applications. Server components and app router show promise.

entries.label: React
entries.description: Our standard frontend library. Large ecosystem and strong community.

entries.label: Flutter
entries.description: Cross-platform mobile development. Evaluating for our mobile applications.

entries.label: Rust
entries.description: Exploring for performance-critical services. Memory safety without garbage collection.

entries.label: PostgreSQL
entries.description: Our default relational database. Reliable, feature-rich, and well-supported.

entries.label: Supabase
entries.description: Backend-as-a-service built on PostgreSQL. Evaluating for rapid prototyping and smaller projects.

entries.label: AWS
entries.description: Primary cloud provider. Well-established infrastructure and team knowledge.

entries.label: Kubernetes
entries.description: Container orchestration standard. Running all production workloads.

entries.label: GitHub Actions
entries.description: Our CI/CD platform. Integrated with our GitHub workflow.

entries.label: Kafka
entries.description: Event streaming platform. Evaluating for event-driven architectures.

entries.label: Docker
entries.description: Standard containerization tool across all projects.

entries.label: Datadog
entries.description: Evaluating as our unified observability platform.

entries.label: Sentry
entries.description: Error tracking and performance monitoring across all applications.

entries.label: Terraform
entries.description: Infrastructure as code. All cloud resources managed through Terraform.

entries.label: Claude Code
entries.description: AI-powered coding assistant. Evaluating for developer productivity.

entries.label: SonarQube
entries.description: Static code analysis. Exploring for code quality enforcement in CI.

entries.label: Trunk-Based Development
entries.description: Short-lived feature branches merged frequently. Reduces integration pain.

entries.label: Event Sourcing
entries.description: Exploring for audit-heavy domains. Powerful but adds complexity.

entries.label: Micro Frontends
entries.description: Too much operational overhead for our team size. Monolithic frontend preferred for now.

entries.label: API-First Design
entries.description: Design APIs before implementation using OpenAPI specs. Enables parallel frontend/backend work.

entries.label: Architecture Decision Records
entries.description: Lightweight documentation of significant technical decisions. Building the habit across teams.

entries.label: Platform Engineering
entries.description: Internal developer platform to reduce cognitive load. Exploring what this means for our scale.
